audiochannels.description: Number of audio channels (e.g., 1, 2, 6). Set to 0 to keep the number of channels.

audiocodec.description: Audio codec to use. Valid values depend on desttype (e.g., AAC, MP3 for MP4)

audiosamplefmt.description: Audio sample format: 0, 8, 16, 32, 64, F16, F32, F64

autocopy.description: Auto copy option: OFF, MATCH, MATCHLIMIT, STRICT, STRICTLIMIT

decoding_errors.description: Abort on decoding errors. Default is to ignore errors.

desttype.description: Destination format: AIFF, ALAC, BMP, FLAC, HLS, JPG, MOV, MP3, MP4, MKV, OGG, Opus, PNG, ProRes, TS, WAV, WebM

hide_extensions.description: List of file extensions to exclude from output (supports wildcards)

hwaccel_dec.description: Hardware decoding API: NONE, VAAPI, MMAL

hwaccel_dec_blocked.description: List of codecs (and optionally profiles) to block for hardware decoding (e.g., ['H264', 'VP9:0'])

hwaccel_enc.description: Hardware encoding API: NONE, VAAPI, OMX

include_extensions.description: List of file extensions to encode (supports wildcards)

level.description: Output level (MP4 only): PROXY, LT, STANDARD, HQ

log_maxlevel.description: Maximum log level: ERROR, WARNING, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE

logfile.description: Path to log file. Empty by default.

max_inactive_abort.description: Time to continue transcoding after client disconnect before aborting

max_inactive_suspend.description: Time to continue transcoding after client disconnect before suspending

max_threads.description: Maximum transcoding threads (0 = unlimited). Default is 16 times number of CPU cores.

min_diskspace.description: Minimum required disk space for cache (e.g., 1G). 0 = no minimum.

min_dvd_chapter_duration.description: Minimum DVD chapter duration to transcode (seconds). Set to 0 to disable.

min_seek_time_diff.description: HLS minimum seek time difference in seconds (float)

noalbumarts.description: Disable copying album art into output

prebuffer_size.description: Prebuffer size in bytes (e.g., 100K). Set to 0 to disable.

prebuffer_time.description: Prebuffer duration to allow smooth playback (e.g., 5s). Set to 0 to disable.

profile.description: Output profile (MP4 only): NONE, FF, EDGE, IE, CHROME, SAFARI, OPERA, MAXTHON

recodesame.description: Recode to same format: NO, YES

videocodec.description: Video codec to use. Valid values depend on desttype (e.g., H264, H265 for MP4)

videoheight.description: Target video height in pixels (0 = keep source)

videowidth.description: Target video width in pixels (0 = keep source)

win_smb_fix.description: Enable Windows SMB workaround. Defaults to on.
